verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents API keys scoped to projects, with per-project usage tracking. It also documents short-lived temporary keys meant to avoid exposing long-lived keys, and admin tokens that create projects and manage API keys programmatically. Together these give an agent bounded, separately managed credentials. Missing for 10: evidence of permission- or action-level scoping (e.g., read-only or endpoint-restricted keys), detailed documentation of temporary-key TTL and scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
